description: Publish a complete natural-English README as the default repository homepage and preserve the current complete Chinese positioning as README.zh-CN.md. Both entry points must remain meaning-equivalent and link to each other without claiming unverified support.
acceptance_criteria: README.md is a complete natural-English presentation of Yaya Loop
README.zh-CN.md preserves the complete Simplified Chinese presentation
Both README files contain working text-based language links to each other
All repository-relative links resolve and the documented behavior matches the implemented internationalization workflow
notes: Initial human acceptance passed on 2026-08-26. The repair makes the fresh/equivalent independent-context gate and failure boundary mandatory in both languages, aligns the Chinese Legacy summary with Bootstrap, and restores natural English. Regression tests now pin these paired invariants. Automated verification after repair: all 58 repository tests passed; every relative README link resolves; English prose contains no Han text outside the Simplified Chinese language label; both language links resolve; no conversation URLs remain; git diff checks passed. Repaired visible documentation is awaiting repeated human acceptance.
